dmp.description:
This Data Management Plan (DMP) defines how data generated in the scope of PearGAIN are collected, documented, stored, shared, and preserved throughout the project lifecycle. PearGAIN  DOI: 10.54499/2023.17358.ICDT is co-funded by Lisboa2030, Programa Inovação e Transição Digital (COMPETE2030), Portugal2030 and the European Union, and by National Funds through Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia (FCT), I.P. (COMPETE2030-FEDER-00705000, Project n. 15927).
PearGAIN will generate plant phenotypic data, DNA and RNA sequencing data, surveys, and data analysis pipelines. Accordingly, the DMP will outline standards for data formats, metadata, software, security, and ethical compliance, ensuring strict alignment with FAIR principles. To support transparency, reproducibility, and future reuse of project outputs, the DMP will also specify responsibilities, storage infrastructure, access policies, and long-term archiving strategies.

project.description: PearGAIN aims to characterize the molecular entry points associated with E. amylovora infection in the 'Rocha' pear cultivar. By validating these molecular targets, we will establish a proof of concept for using gene editing to improve resistance while preserving varietal characteristics. The objective is to bring the 'Rocha' pear to the forefront of research on New Genomic Techniques and leverage its economic potential.
